Artist profile

No
single
lane.

Dustinnope is an independent, genre-crossing recording artist whose public catalog moves through hip-hop/rap, pop, blues, R&B, and country.

Release credits identify Dustin Gatlin as composer and producer, with Dustinnope credited as main artist and lead vocalist. The catalog spans hard-edged rap, relationship records, blues storytelling, and left-turn pop—connected by direct titles and an appetite for switching forms.
